statement: Newegg listed NVIDIA H100 80GB PCIe cards at $32,879.00 in stock, with alternative offers from $29,500.00, an H100 NVL at $30,999.00 out of stock, and an H200 NVL at $35,998.00 with in-stock options.
why: Retail listing prices for accelerator cards are a daily sanity check on the secondary hardware market, but with no earlier price stated they show only a level.

impact.mechanism: Retail card prices are a display overlay on secondary-market hardware value; without a stated baseline or change they carry no demand or supply direction.

evidence.excerpt: 'NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM2e PCIE Express GPU Graphics Card New' priced $32,879.00, free shipping.
'NVIDIA H200 NVL AI Accelerator Card 141GB HBM3E' priced $35,998.00 with 'More options from $33,999.00 - $35,998.00', in-stock option available.

confidence.basis: Single retail marketplace listing page at secondary tier; prices are seller-set and unverified elsewhere.

dispersion: H100 PCIe offers range $29,500.00 to $32,879.00; H200 NVL offers range $33,999.00 to $35,998.00.
